root_cause: Image::new, RawImage::new and the RawImage builder defaulted fit to ImageFit::Contain. Flutter leaves Image.fit null, which paintImage resolves to BoxFit.scaleDown when there is no centerSlice (decoration_image.dart:561).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs Image::new (fit ScaleDown); crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/images.rs RawImage builder default and new() (fit ScaleDown). FadeInImage inherits the Image default.
harness: pixel scene image_default_fit: orchestrator to rerun (was 16.41% of pixels over 16 levels at every scale).
api_change: Default behaviour change: an Image or RawImage without an explicit fit now scales down instead of containing. Callers that relied on enlarging small sources must pass ImageFit::Contain explicitly.
limitations: ImageFit::default() (the enum #[default]) still reports Contain. Only the image descriptor defaults changed, to keep the blast radius to image widgets.

root_cause: DecorationImage defaulted fit to ImageFit::Cover. Flutter DecorationImage.fit is null; paintImage resolves null to scaleDown without a centerSlice and to fill with one.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/decoration.rs: DecorationImage.fit is Option<ImageFit> (builder strip_option) with resolved_fit(). crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/box_painter.rs: decoration_image_widget uses resolved_fit().
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/painting_effects.rs::painting_data_builders_match_existing_defaults_and_conversions (fit None and resolved ScaleDown; with centerSlice Fill; explicit Cover kept)
harness: pixel scene decoration_image_default_fit: orchestrator to rerun (was 35.94% at every scale).
api_change: DecorationImage::fit field type changed from ImageFit to Option<ImageFit>. The builder call .fit(ImageFit::X) is unchanged. Direct field reads need resolved_fit(). No workspace crate reads the field directly.
limitations: With a centerSlice set the resolved fit is Fill, as in Flutter, but the image is not nine-sliced (see paint-016).

root_cause: PhysicalShape lowered to ClipPath::new(clipper, child) only. It dropped the fill color, the elevation shadow and the configured clip, and ClipPath defaults to an anti-aliased clip where Flutter PhysicalShape defaults to Clip.none.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/layers.rs PhysicalShape: clip_behavior (default Clip::None) and clip_behavior(). From<PhysicalShape> builds Stack [Positioned fill, child] with Passthrough fit. The fill is a LayoutBuilder producing a CustomPaint of the path in color, wrapped in the elevation DropShadow when elevation > 0. The child is wrapped in ClipPath only when clip_behavior is set.
harness: pixel scene physical_shape_triangle: orchestrator to rerun. A residual shadow difference is expected (see limitations).
api_change: New builder method clip_behavior on PhysicalShape. The default changes from an anti-aliased clip to none, matching Flutter.
limitations: The elevation shadow is the existing offset and blur approximation shared with PhysicalModel, not Skia drawShadow (ambient and spot model), so shadow pixels will differ from Flutter.
note: Confirmed by reading RenderPhysicalShape and the old lowering before the change.

root_cause: PhysicalModel had no shape field and converted only to DecoratedBox or DropShadow. Its clip_behavior was stored but never applied to the child.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/layers.rs PhysicalModel: shape (BoxShape, default Rectangle) and shape(). Circle surfaces use a DecoratedBox circle decoration. A clip_behavior other than none clips the child with ClipOval (circle) or ClipRRect (rectangle, using border_radius). Shared elevation_shadow helper.
harness: pixel scene physical_model_circle: the Incular twin in harness/incular/tests/pixels.rs has no shape setter. Orchestrator should add .shape(BoxShape::Circle) to that twin (a diagnostic twin that can now use the new API) and rerun.
limitations: The animated wrapper's missing circle option is implicit-005 and is not covered here. The elevation shadow uses the shared approximation (see paint-004).

root_cause: ClipRSuperellipse lowered to ClipRRect with circular corner arcs, although Path::rounded_superellipse exists.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/layers.rs From<ClipRSuperellipse>: a LayoutBuilder over constraints.biggest() builds Path::rounded_superellipse and wraps the child in ClipPath with the requested clip_behavior. This uses the same sizing rule as ClipPath::shape.
harness: pixel scene clip_r_superellipse: orchestrator to rerun (was 0.61% at 1x, max 122).
api_change: none. The lowering type changed from ClipRRect to LayoutBuilder; the public type is unchanged.
limitations: The outline is built for the largest size the constraints allow, so under loose constraints it is not the child's size. Tight constraints, the common case, are exact.

root_cause: ShapeDecoration had no image stage. Its paint covered only the color or gradient and the border.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/shape_decoration.rs: image field (Option<DecorationImage>) and image() builder. DecoratedShapeBox paints the fill, then the image clipped to the outer path (via box_painter::decoration_image_widget, shared with BoxDecoration), then the border. paint() is kept; paint_fill() and paint_outline() are added. Literal construction sites got image: None in crates/incular-material/src/inputs/text_selection_toolbar.rs (2 sites) and crates/incular-widgets/src/magnifier.rs (1 site).
api_change: ShapeDecoration gained a public image field. Struct literals must add image; the three literal sites in other crates were updated. ShapeDecoration::new(..) callers are unaffected.
note: Out-of-ownership edits: incular-material text_selection_toolbar.rs and incular-widgets magnifier.rs only add the image: None field.

root_cause: RawImage exposed only dimensions, scale, tint, fit and repeat.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/images.rs RawImage: alignment(), filter_quality(), opacity() (clamped to 0..=1, wraps the image in Opacity), and invert_colors() (Flutter invert matrix via ColorFilter::flutter_matrix, applied before the tint).
limitations: Partial fix. Not implemented: centerSlice (nine-slice, the same missing stage as paint-016), matchTextDirection (the painter has no ambient text direction), colorBlendMode other than the constant tint, and the anti-alias flag.
note: Outcome is deferred because the finding list is only partly covered. The implemented subset is fixed.

root_cause: FadeInImage had no repeat or filter-quality options. Its error builders need a provider error stream that does not exist (paint-012).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/fade_in_image.rs: repeat(), image_filter_quality() and placeholder_filter_quality(), forwarded to both Image descriptors. The fade timeline is unchanged.
limitations: Partial fix. Not implemented: imageErrorBuilder and placeholderErrorBuilder (blocked on paint-012), separate image color and blend mode, and matchTextDirection. The default fit follows paint-002.

root_cause: ColorFilter::matrix stores normalized 0..1 translations, but Flutter ColorFilter.matrix translation column is in 0..255. The matrix layout matched Flutter; the bias units did not.
change: crates/incular-rendering/src/effects.rs ColorFilter::flutter_matrix(): the same row-major 4x5 input in Flutter units. Indices 4, 9, 14 and 19 are divided by 255. ColorFilter::matrix is unchanged (normalized).
harness: pixel scene color_filter_matrix_bias: the Incular twin in harness/incular/tests/pixels.rs passes Flutter units to ColorFilter::matrix. Orchestrator should switch that twin to ColorFilter::flutter_matrix (a diagnostic twin that can now use the new API) and rerun (was 25% at every scale).
api_change: New ColorFilter::flutter_matrix constructor (additive). ColorFilter::matrix keeps its normalized meaning.
limitations: Flutter ColorFilter.mode and gamma filters are not covered (see paint-008).

root_cause: Four accepted parameters are stored but never painted: BoxDecoration.background_blend_mode (needs a blended background stage), DecorationImage.center_slice (needs a nine-slice stage), DecorationImage.match_text_direction (needs an ambient TextDirection in the decoration painter), and BoxShadow.blur_style (needs solid and clipped blur variants in the blur stage).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/decoration.rs: doc comments now state that each field is accepted but not applied. Behaviour is unchanged. No construction-time rejection was added, because is_valid() gates painting and rejecting would silently drop decorations.
harness: Proposed diagnostic scene decoration_center_slice (orchestrator; needs a non-uniform fixture), see pixel-run.md.
limitations: Remaining work: each parameter needs a renderer stage (background blend, image nine-slice, text-direction plumbing, blur style variants). Recorded as blocked, not fixed.
note: Decision for the orchestrator: reject these at construction instead, or keep documenting them.

root_cause: The ShapeBorder family had Stadium, RoundedRectangle, RoundedSuperellipse and Star only.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/shape_borders.rs: CircleBorder (zero eccentricity), OvalBorder and BeveledRectangleBorder, each with outer, inner and paint paths and Lerp, plus ellipse_path and bevel_path helpers. Exported from painting_effects.rs and the crate root.
api_change: Additive: three new public ShapeBorder types and their re-exports from incular-widgets.
limitations: Partial fix. Not implemented: ContinuousRectangleBorder (needs Flutter's continuous-corner curve construction) and LinearBorder (sides, start and end, and ordering model). CircleBorder ignores Flutter's eccentricity parameter. BoxShape::Circle is still not a ShapeBorder conversion.

root_cause: Focal radial gradients were already supported (RadialGradient.focal/focal_radius, WGPU kind 4 two-point conical). GradientRotation had no equivalent on Brush.
change: WGPU pass (wgpu-effects): crates/incular-rendering/src/gradients.rs Brush::rotated(radians, bounds), Flutter's GradientRotation.transform(bounds): rotates linear endpoints, radial centre and focal, and sweep centre about the bounds centre, and advances a sweep start angle. Exact for every brush, so no renderer change was needed.
harness: none; the positioned_gradient proposal in pixel-run.md can use Brush::rotated.
limitations: General GradientTransform matrices (non-uniform scale, skew) are still not representable by the Brush value; only rotation (the only GradientTransform Flutter ships) is covered. Widgets that build gradients from alignments (decoration.rs) take Brush values directly, so callers apply rotated() themselves.
note: Focal part already-fixed before this pass.

root_cause: AssetImage implemented only load(), so ImageConfiguration.device_pixel_ratio was ignored.
change: crates/incular-image/src/lib.rs: AssetImage::variant_path(dpr) and load_with(). Variants are <N>x directories beside the main asset. The best one is chosen by the _findBestVariant rules (exact match, nearest key, low-DPR limit 2.0, midpoint rule; the main asset is key 1.0). Unreadable directories fall back to the main asset.
api_change: Additive: AssetImage::variant_path(f64) -> PathBuf. load_with now resolves variants; load() is unchanged.
limitations: Locale variants are not implemented, and this is not a gap against Flutter: image_resolution.dart has a TODO and does not select by locale, text direction or size either, so the finding's locale claim is invalid. Variant discovery reads the directory on each load_with call (no cache).
note: Fallback order compared against _findBestVariant in image_resolution.dart, not against Flutter's manifest-based key lookup.

root_cause: No WGPU shader-mask stage existed. The first pass replaced the frame failure with an unmasked fallback, which presented the child as if the mask had succeeded. In addition, the destination-read blend shader had no branch for BlendMode::Modulate (code 22), Flutter's ShaderMask default, and treated it as an artistic mode.
change: WGPU pass (wgpu-effects): crates/incular-wgpu/src/renderer/lowering.rs PushShaderMask arm calls lower_shader_mask_group. The child renders into the layer's retained group target (offscreen_cache), lower_shader_mask_fill renders the mask rect (mask_size at mask_transform) filled with the brush into the layer's effect texture (effect_cache), and a DrawBatch::Blend with the new BlendSource::Effect blends it over the child, scissored to the mask rect, with the mask blend mode (fixed-function Porter-Duff pipelines for srcIn/dstIn/srcATop etc., destination-read ping-pong for modulate and artistic modes). The group composites into the parent with srcOver. render_plan.rs: BlendSource on DrawBatch::Blend; rendering.rs: Blend encode reads either cache; effects.rs: render_batches_into; shaders/blend_shader.wgsl: modulate branch (premultiplied src*dst). The unmasked fallback and unmasked_shader_mask_stages are removed; diagnostics counter shader_mask_passes counts mask fills.
tests: crates/incular-desktop/tests/unsupported_effect_execution.rs (live GPU: mask phase now presents a left-bright/right-dark fade)
harness: No ShaderMask pixel scene exists; proposed scene shader_mask_linear_fade for the orchestrator (see paint.md). Live desktop test run with INCULAR_DESKTOP_LIVE_TESTS=1: passed.
api_change: RendererCounters::unmasked_shader_mask_stages replaced by shader_mask_passes (both uncommitted). RendererError::UnsupportedShaderMask kept, not produced: every Brush shader (solid, linear, radial incl. focal, sweep) executes. Behaviour: frames with a ShaderMask are now masked.
limitations: The blend is scissored to the device bounding box of the mask rect, so a rotated or skewed mask_transform blends the child in the bbox corners outside the rotated rect (Flutter leaves them unchanged); translation and axis-aligned scale are exact. Like other effect groups, the group is lowered with the translation part of the parent transform only. mask_transform is the widget's world transform snapshotted at resolve time (render_object/layers.rs); if a scroll or Transform layer moves the mask without a repaint, the mask stays at the old place. Suggested follow-up (compositor.rs, not owned): emit the live flatten world_transform as mask_transform.
note: Confirmed before fixing by reading the lowering arm (child painted unmasked) and blend_shader.wgsl (no mode 22 branch).

root_cause: BackdropFilter stores a GaussianBlur and an optional matrix only. No renderer-neutral image-filter value exists.
change: none (wgpu-effects pass did not reach it).
limitations: API surface too large for this pass: a renderer-neutral image-filter enum (dilate, erode, compose), its WGPU execution, and the compositor path. Blur and matrix backdrops already execute.

root_cause: ImageFiltered stored only a sigma or BlurController and lowered to Blur. It had no enabled flag.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/images.rs ImageFiltered: enabled flag (default true) and enabled(). A disabled filter lowers to its child. wgpu-effects pass: no further change.
harness: none (the existing blur pixel scene covers the enabled case).
limitations: Partial fix. Non-blur image filters (matrix, compose, dilate/erode) on an arbitrary subtree remain: they need the paint-001 image-filter value plus a WGPU resample stage over a layer source.

root_cause: ColorFiltered accepts only the 4x5 matrix form (rendering ColorFilter). Flutter mode, linearToSrgbGamma and srgbToLinearGamma filters were absent.
change: WGPU pass (wgpu-effects): crates/incular-rendering/src/effects.rs ColorFilter::mode(color, mode) -> Option<ColorFilter>: exact matrices for src, srcIn, dstIn, srcOut, dstOut, srcATop and modulate (straight-alpha results affine in the destination). Other modes return None. ColorFiltered takes the result unchanged, executed by the existing color-matrix stage.
limitations: Partial. srcOver, dstOver, dstATop, xor, plus and the artistic modes are not matrix-expressible and return None; they need a color-blend shader stage (a solid source blended over the layer via the destination-read blend shader would work). Gamma filters (linearToSrgbGamma, srgbToLinearGamma) are non-linear and still need a new shader stage.

root_cause: Image takes an already-decoded ImageHandle. incular-image has an ImageProvider trait, but no widget consumes it, and there is no stream, chunk-event, multi-frame or precache state.
limitations: Blocker: a provider-backed Image state machine (load, frame builder, loading builder, error builder, gaplessPlayback replacement) is an API design decision and a retained-state addition across the widget tree. Remaining work: connect ImageProvider to a retained image state. Not attempted in this pass.
note: Blocked on the API shape, which the orchestrator should decide.
